tagline: Leading provider of dental and healthcare products and technologies
hero_kpi_rationale: Research and development investments are crucial for medical and dental device companies to remain competitive and continuously innovate. For NVST, this KPI is a key indicator of its innovation strategy and new product development.

kpis.name: R&D Investments (% of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses as a percentage of total revenue.
kpis.description: Measures the company's effort in developing new technologies and products.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of innovation and future competitiveness.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Indicates the direct profitability of the company's products or services.
kpis.signal: Reflects production efficiency and pricing strategy.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting operating expenses.
kpis.description: Indicates the company's ability to generate profits from its core operations.
kpis.signal: Measures overall operational profitability before interest and taxes.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures (equipment spending)
kpis.explanation: Spending dedicated to acquiring or upgrading long-term physical assets.
kpis.description: Represents expenditures on tangible and intangible fixed assets.
kpis.signal: Indicates investments in future production capacity.

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees working for the company.
kpis.description: Total number of people employed by the company.
kpis.signal: Indicator of the organization's size and growth.

ai_positioning.summary: No specific information regarding the company's position on artificial intelligence is available in the provided excerpts.
